definition: Perturbs means disturbs or troubles; makes uneasy.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word perturbs. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know perturbs should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: The silence from the usually noisy server room perturbs the night technician, who keeps inventing reasons to walk past its door.
What distracts you merely pulls at your attention — milder than perturbs, which leaves real unease behind.
Alarms goes further than perturbs: alarm announces that danger is here, while perturbs only whispers that something is off.

To unsettle someone is to shake their calm without terrifying them — the ground shifts once and the composure wobbles. What perturbs a person goes on working afterward: a quieter unease that keeps returning, whispering that something is off long after the first jolt has passed.

Rattles is the informal word for throwing someone off their usual balance — a heckler rattles a rookie pitcher for an inning. It is sharp, visible, and soon over. Perturbs works lower and longer: quiet unease that troubles sleep rather than performance, with nothing to point at.

To fluster someone is to make them flustered and clumsy in the moment — dropped notes, tangled words, a red face. It ends when the moment does. What perturbs you follows you home: no clumsiness at all, just a worry that resurfaces and will not name itself.
